parsed.explanation: The decisive exposures are traveller-facing. National passport/visa rules no longer issue X markers, permit refusal where sex is doubted, and contemplate lifetime fraud findings; border outing can strand a visitor, and immigration custody has documented beatings and sexual abuse. The division adds a birth-sex restroom/locker rule in public schools and government buildings, enforced by complaints and a public reporting form; the documentary defence relies on records visitors generally will not carry, with no out-of-state route. Private hotels and gyms fall outside it, no police sweeps or complaint outcomes are documented, and hate-crime, ID-amendment and employment/housing protections exist. This is not organised street targeting or near-certain imprisonment, but universal border/document risk plus an unremedied facility rule place it in High Risk around 0.35.
